title: Jack Black as Steve Painting
description: This adds the Jack Black as Steve painting by Zetterstrand, pixelated and adapted into a minecraft painting!
body: This pack replaces the Burning Skull 4x4 painting with the new Jack Black as Steve painting by Zetterstrand. It has been pixelated and modified to fit with minecrafts other paintings for your pleasure. Feel free to hang it up wherever!
